in_sanskrit.name: Minaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Minaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mīnā’ meaning 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon goddess is known as ‘Chandra Mata’, who is believed to bless her devotees with prosperity and happiness.
